acceptance_boundary.adr: ADR-0043 remains progress until NI2-012 through NI2-014 real fan-out runtime and replacement gates complete.
acceptance_boundary.sprint: N2.2a earns its +6% only when NI2-010 and NI2-011 together satisfy the routed-edge exit.
acceptance_boundary.task: NI2-011 may become accepted after every mandatory model/API/migration/replay/compatibility gate passes on one frozen source cut.

atomicity_and_replay.horizon: After receipt/payload horizon release, return a typed expiry; never allocate a replacement route.
atomicity_and_replay.lost_ack: Authenticate the current caller first, then return the stored outcome for an identical accepted semantic digest. Never recompute an accepted route from current assignments or target counts. Mismatched payload/key/state/routing conflicts.
atomicity_and_replay.outcome_digest: Bind the persisted edge IDs, target partition IDs, allocated edge sequences and reference record IDs.
atomicity_and_replay.paths: Extend both source append and operator complete through one shared route helper inside their existing AsyncSession transaction.
atomicity_and_replay.semantic_digest: Bind graph/routing digest, stable original input or source coordinate, kind/value/state, canonical key, producer partition/sequence and output ordinal. Exclude worker, PID, grant and run_count.

authorization.source: user approval of ADR-0042 through ADR-0048 at fae53c90aa3b44dbc45032833b4d193001e5c8bd

compatibility_and_fences: Reuse StreamPartition, StreamRecord, StreamConsumer and StreamCompletion; do not create a second data plane or client mailbox.
Preserve bounded-linear-v1 and partitioned-fixed-v1 bytes and behavior.
Keep public DAG execution, old stream endpoints and terminal Flow lifecycle fenced until NI2-012.
SQLite supports paired migration and structural metadata checks only; route mutation is PostgreSQL 17 fail-closed.
Fan-in, joins, state materialization, cancellation/drain, online GC and cross-sink atomicity are out of NI2-011.

delivery_slices.exit: Paired ORM/migrations for direct PAYLOAD/REFERENCE identity, route receipt and stable subscriber cursor fields; legacy rows round-trip unchanged.
Pure deterministic routing planner and exact canonical key/semantic/outcome digests cover all four exchanges and bounds.
Shared transactional source-append/operator-complete helper atomically inserts payload, references, receipt, state and cursor, with lost-ACK replay.
Independent branch cursor/EOF/pin and concurrency tests prove no cross-branch acknowledgement, partial route or lock-order inversion.
Paired client DTO/key wrapper mirror and package/type/legacy regressions; runtime execution stays fenced pending NI2-012.

dependencies.NI2-010: accepted metadata-only DAG component; no usable lifecycle
dependencies.adr: ADR-0043 A43-03 and A43-09 remain open

eof.empty_target: Persist EOF for targets that received no records.
eof.failure: A failed contributor cannot manufacture COMPLETED. Permanent branch failure/drain and global failure policy remain NI2-012/ADR-0045 boundaries.
eof.rule: A target edge partition reaches EOF only after every sealed contributing producer partition is terminal and every accepted route is committed.

goal: Atomically materialize bounded forward, rebalance, broadcast and keyed deliveries as independent existing-partition records with exact retry receipts. This task does not enable public DAG execution.
locking: graph/routing revision SHARE and refreshed declaration
current subtask/grant SHARE when execution is later enabled
one UUID-sorted union of own input, producer output and every selected target StreamPartition UPDATE
completion, route receipt, PAYLOAD and REFERENCE rows
mandatory_tests: forward, rebalance, broadcast and keyed deterministic vectors at different target parallelism
same semantic request after lost ACK returns identical reference IDs/sequences/outcome digest
changed key, payload, managed state or routing digest conflicts without mutation
one target at capacity rolls back producer payload, every reference, receipt, cursor and state
two concurrent producers lock the same edge partitions without deadlock, duplicates or sequence holes
completing/reading branch B never advances branch C cursor or releases C pins
EOF waits for every sealed contributor and closes an empty target exactly once
reference resolver verifies original payload identity/digest and refuses chains/corrupt/missing payloads
legacy bounded-linear/fixed-P2 record decode and terminal paths remain byte/behavior compatible
SQLite and unsupported backend refuse route mutation before any write

ownership.architect: ADR/task mapping, hostile review, fresh PostgreSQL/SQLite/concurrency replay verification and acceptance status
ownership.root: CI selection, clean checkpoint, hosted evidence and integration Git only
ownership.runtime: terminal key extraction and route-call integration only after paired wire freeze; no public start/wait in this task
ownership.sdk: paired client schemas/methods, KeyedStreamOutput/SourceRecord wire contract and stripped package tests after server DTO freeze
ownership.server: ORM, paired migrations, schemas, route planner/receipts, transactional store helper and server tests

representation.consumer: Each target physical subtask keeps its own input StreamPartition and independent StreamConsumer cursor. Stable receipt/cursor identity is subscriber_uid + input_port + edge_partition, not attempt/run_count.
representation.edge_partition: StreamGraphEdgePartition.stream_id points to the existing server-owned StreamPartition. Edge partitions are multiproducer FIFO logs, are never claimed as producer partitions, and keep their own contiguous sequence.
representation.payload: Store the user value once as a PAYLOAD StreamRecord in the existing producer StreamPartition.
representation.reference: Store one direct REFERENCE StreamRecord in each selected existing edge StreamPartition. Add an explicit record discriminator and direct immutable payload-record FK/identity; refuse chains and raw-envelope delivery.
representation.retention: Reference rows and independent consumers conservatively pin their payload and route receipt. Online GC remains deferred; deletion must remove references before payloads.

routing.bounds: Use sealed max operators=16, edges=32, P<=16 and total subtasks<=128. Resolve the full bounded target set before mutation; one full target or any encoded/record limit refusal rejects the entire turn.
routing.broadcast: Create one reference for every sealed target partition.
routing.forward: Require equal producer/target parallelism and route producer subtask i to target i.
routing.keyed: tagged-key-v1 bytes; full SHA-256 integer modulo persisted key_group_count; target = floor(group * target_parallelism / key_group_count).

wire_and_key_contract.key: One canonical output key is encoded by tagged-key-v1 and reused by every keyed outgoing edge. No server callback, business-payload reserved field or user function runs on the server.
wire_and_key_contract.operator: A keyed operator yields KeyedStreamOutput(value, key).
wire_and_key_contract.plain_yield: Plain YIELD remains valid for graphs with no outgoing keyed edge. If any selected outgoing edge is keyed, an absent/invalid key refuses the whole turn before acceptance.
wire_and_key_contract.return: RETURN remains state-only and produces no route. YIELD(None) remains a real payload.
wire_and_key_contract.source: A keyed source yields SourceRecord(position, KeyedStreamOutput(value, key)); the outer SourceRecord retains source position.
